PostToolUse(AskUserQuestion) fires only after a human answers the question, so it cannot be captured by an unattended session (claude -p); no owner was present when SH-09 W2-2 was built. The `payload` below is a SYNTHETIC composition of (1) the PostToolUse envelope keys that WERE measured live on host 2.1.272 for the Skill tool (../host-payloads/PostToolUse.Skill.json) and (2) the documented AskUserQuestion tool input shape. Every value is synthetic (ids, question text, labels); there is no user data in this file. When a real capture exists, freeze it as ../host-payloads/PostToolUse.AskUserQuestion.json and diff it against this file; do not edit this one to match.
